regression.scope: blast radius of the diff — statistics widgets on both surfaces + neighbours
regression.not_implemented_basis: Source-confirmed, not an env limitation: useSalesRepPeriodFilter exists (lifetime/month/year) but both consumers destructure only from/to and never expose the mutable period ref — top-sellers.vue pins "year", sales-rep-orders.vue defaults to "lifetime", and neither template renders a control. These cases are ahead of the build. The AC's 'refetch on filter change' was instead proven on two other axes: customer switch (organizationId) and category chip (filter) both refetch.
regression.blocked_basis: SR-HD-014 needs one widget's op to fail while siblings succeed. No admin lever produces that — all four sales-rep ops share one scoped endpoint and auth scope, so revoking permission fails all of them and route-guards the hub (a different assertion), while removing membership only changes data (200s, no error path). Deliberately did NOT mutate a shared env. Zero-risk partial obtained: an unserved-org profile URL renders a graceful localized 'Customer not found or not in your customers.' with the rail interactive, no crash. Recommend re-homing as a vitest test with a mocked erroring Apollo link.

post_seed_reverification.why: The original seed (1 order, 0 carts, 1 product) left assertions unevaluable and confounded F2, since BL-SR-003 makes a null *ChangePercent correct when the previous baseline is 0.
post_seed_reverification.seeded: 9 orders / $1,937.00 / AOV $215.22, 2 active carts ($37.00), 5 ranked products, a second served org (orderingCustomers 0 -> 4)
post_seed_reverification.method_upgrade: Cross-checked against the UI's own live GraphQL request documents — what it asks for vs what it renders — not only against the probe values.
post_seed_reverification.planned_discriminator_that_failed: The intended lever — a real +100% week-over-week on the carts tile — cannot reach the UI: SalesRepCustomerCartStatistics does not select comparison at all, and the UI's own prevWeek window is a single day (Jul 27, matching elapsed week-to-date since Aug 3 is a Monday) while the prior cart is dated Jul 28. The probe's +100% came from its wider 7-day window. The order tiles settled the question instead.
post_seed_reverification.permanent_constraint_discovered: Order createdDate is server-assigned and unwritable (verified live: POST with a backdated createdDate read back as now; PUT ignored). Previous-week / previous-month / last-year baselines therefore cannot be seeded at all. Zero-cost future path: prevMonth is the same day-span in the previous month, so the pre-existing 2026-07-16 order enters it from 2026-08-17 onward.
post_seed_reverification.sanity_check: One SPA cycle still fired exactly 3 requests (207/208/209) with byte-identical variables; SalesRepTopSellers still does not refire. Fix holds with the richer data.

findings.status: CONFIRMED for the dashboard, CORRECTED for the profile (post-seed re-verification)
findings.summary: Dashboard tiles discard data the API returns: no AOV (mtd.average $215.22 / ytd.average $207.02 fetched, never rendered) and no period-over-period indicator even though non-null signed totalChange ($1,937.00 / $1,937.00 / $2,070.20) and countChange (9/9/10) are fetched. SalesRepCustomerCounts never selects comparison at all, so SR-HD-007's MoM indicator cannot render by construction. Profile MTD tile shows a share-of-YTD ratio (79%, correct math) and neither count nor MTD AOV.
findings.correction: The original finding implied the profile too. It does NOT: the profile has a dedicated 'Avg order value $105.03 / Average per order (YTD)' tile matching ytd.average exactly. F2 is re-scoped to dashboard-only.
findings.no_longer_confounded_because: BL-SR-003 only excuses a NULL *ChangePercent when the previous baseline is 0. The signed totalChange/countChange are non-null and still unrendered, so the null-percent defence does not apply.
findings.recommendation: Either render average / totalChange, or correct the {SPEC} assertions in SR-HD-004/005/007 and SR-CP-028/030 to the implemented design. Graceful degradation holds — no NaN / Infinity / raw null anywhere.

findings.status: UNRESOLVED — not observable in either direction
findings.summary: No loading indication observable during the in-flight window across 5 attempts including a cold hard load. Two causes cannot be separated with real-user tooling: the round trip finishes inside a tool tick, and an overlay with no role/aria-busy would be invisible to the a11y tree even if present. The ticket's expected result #4 ('a loading indicator is shown during the refetch') therefore stays unconfirmed both ways.
findings.recommendation: Check at component level or via a trace/video. Note that a loading state carrying no aria-busy would itself be an accessibility gap.

findings.status: RESOLVED — NOT a defect (reclassified from 'possible arithmetic issue' to a specification question)
findings.summary: The order line item reads Price per item $233.00 x Qty 1, line total $186.40 with $233.00 struck through, and the summary reconciles as 233.00 - 149.80 discount + 50.00 shipping = $133.20. So salesRepTopSellers.revenue is the extended LIST price, gross of discount — the arithmetic is correct. Confirmed by the ACME aggregate: line revenue $730.00 vs order totals $630.20, a $99.80 gap that is exactly 149.80 - 50.00.
findings.recommendation: Clarify BL-SR-008, which says only that revenue is Money and never states gross vs net. A column labelled 'Revenue' reporting gross list price overstates revenue whenever a promotion applies.

findings.routed_to: backend / xAPI contract question, not a storefront defect
findings.summary: Empty carts appear to be counted as active in DATED windows: ytd count 4 / total $37.00 and prevWeek count 1 / total $0.00 — four carts, only two carrying value. Matches BL-SR-006's violation signal ('empty carts counted as active'), first observed at API level during seeding (count 1 -> 2 after creating an empty org-scoped cart, back to 1 after deletion).
findings.no_ui_violation: The tile's displayed 2 is consistent with the two genuinely non-empty carts ($25.00 + $12.00 = $37.00); the tile is fed by the undated activeCarts period.
findings.alternative_explanation_not_excluded: A currency-scoped total (a non-USD cart counting while contributing $0.00 to a USD total) cannot be ruled out from the storefront — needs an API-level probe of the two zero-value YTD carts.
